claims: Milwaukee Brewers opened the 2026 season with a 14-2 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Thursday, March 26, at American Family Field.
Jacob Misiorowski set a Milwaukee Brewers Opening Day record with 11 strikeouts.
Final score was Milwaukee Brewers 14, Chicago White Sox 2.
Milwaukee Brewers hit two home runs.
Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love threw out the ceremonial first pitch.
Outfielder Jackson Chourio was placed on the 10-day injured list with a broken left hand.
Milwaukee Brewers' 2025 season included a trip to the National League Championship Series
